target_customer: Pet owners in Colombia, then Mexico and Chile
problem: Pet owners had to visit many places for products, vet and grooming services.
business_model: Pet e-commerce with product margin, membership and services
product_category: Pet products and services e-commerce platform

founders.name: Manuela Sanchez
founders.background_notes: Sister of Camilo per Bloomberg Linea.

founders.name: Tulio Jimenez
founders.background_notes: A Spanish source also names Andrea Gonzalez as a creator.

technical_complexity.rationale: E-commerce with delivery logistics; difficulty is operational (inventory, delivery) more than software.

defensibility.rationale: Membership and logistics scale help but products are commodity and many sellers exist.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not documented for the batch period; Laika raised a 48M Series B in 2022 from SoftBank and later reports mention a temporary exit from Mexico and re-entry.

market_need_then: Portafolio reported in 2019 that Laika addressed fragmented pet purchases, and related Portafolio coverage says six in ten Colombian households own a pet.

identity.voice_and_tone: Friendly pet lover tone (Time Out Mexico headline).

branding.brand_signature: Name Laika, shared with the first dog sent to orbit

brand_strength.rationale: Strong local press in Portafolio, Pulzo and Time Out Mexico and a memorable name; no source on merch or community.

outcome_analysis: Laika grew from a Colombian pet store into a three country platform, reporting 5x growth, 300,000 active users and 500 employees by January 2022, funded by seed, Series A and a 48M SoftBank led Series B. Strong membership sales and strong local press drove momentum; later retrenchment from Mexico is mentioned in coverage but not detailed.
notes: Total raised conflicts (65M Dealroom vs 125M StartupIntros). Seed month unknown and the seed is a single LAVCA mention. Pulzo does not state why Laika was chosen so name origin is null; the link to the space dog is an association, not a sourced origin. No 2019 dated competitor source found so list left empty. Founding year 2017 per CB Insights, 2018 per Bloomberg Linea. Website not fetched. Seed date corrected to 2020-07 (LAVCA and Contxto 2020-07-09, Forbes Colombia 2020-07-10). Forbes also names S7 Ventures and Alto Pharmacy as investors.
